info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Event Management API
info.description: The Event Management API enables businesses to create and manage events related to open banking activities. This API allows users to submit event data, which can be leveraged for tracking, analytics, and compliance purposes. Ideal for financial institutions and developers working with open banking frameworks, this API facilitates seamless integration of event-driven workflows. Use cases include processing user interactions, financial transactions, and regulatory reporting, ensuring that organizations can maintain accurate records of all pertinent events.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new event in the system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create the event.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating a new event. This should include all necessary details about the event such as title, date, location, and any relevant descriptions or attributes.
